question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a orange present, Bob has a red present, Claire has a grey present, Dave has a black present, and Eve has a white present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Dave and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Eve swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Eve swap their gifts. Finally, Dave and Claire swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Eve has the
Options:
(A) orange present
(B) red present
(C) grey present
(D) black present
(E) white present
solution:
Gift color order: (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve).
Initial: (orange, red, grey, black, white)
1. Dave and Bob swap: (orange, black, grey, red, white)
2. Alice and Bob swap: (black, orange, grey, red, white)
3. Alice and Eve swap: (white, orange, grey, red, black)
4. Dave and Eve swap: (white, orange, grey, black, red)
5. Dave and Claire swap: (white, orange, black, grey, red)
Eve has the red present, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
